meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按代码的语法结构(而非文字)在 25 种语言里查找并改写代码,例如把所有 console.log 改成 logger.info,也能运行 YAML 规则。它自带一个 Python 辅助脚本,改写前默认先试运行预览。
howto.when: 当目标是代码的语法形状(比如「每个长得像 X 的调用/类/导入」、codemod、YAML 规则)而不是字面文本时会触发;若只是找字符串、注释或文件名,则改用 rg。

say.text: 帮我找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按语法结构搜索并列出匹配位置

say.text: 扫描这个项目的 YAML 规则并列出违规

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude finds and rewrites code by syntax shape across 25 languages — e.g. console.log to logger.info, strip as any — and runs YAML rules. A Python helper validates patterns and previews rewrites before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is a syntax shape (a call, class or import shaped like X, a codemod, or a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments or filenames, use rg.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Runs a structural search and lists matches.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x), but preview first.
say_en.note: Dry-run by default; nothing is changed.

say_en.text: Scan this project's YAML rules and list violations.
